## Make Your Own DC.

They say you're obsolete.
Maybe it's the whole idea of "working for someone else" that's obsolete.

In the age of AI, the real question isn't whether machines replace people.
The real question is:
Who owns the machines?
Who owns the pipeline?
Who owns industrialized productivity?

If the answer is always Big Tech,
then AI isn't empowerment.
It's just a new wall.

I'm Eric.

This isn't a demo.
Not a toy.
Not a crippled edition.

This is the industrialized drama-production line our own team runs every day.
From script to storyboard, from assets to finished film — the whole chain.

Because people aren't beasts of burden.
Because creativity is humanity's last line of defense.

What DramaClaw sets out to do is simple:

Tear down the wall.

Put the industrialized drama-production power that only Big Tech had
into the hands of ordinary creators.

The code is here.
If this resonates, leave a ⭐.
We'll keep tearing down walls.

And yes, you can make money with it.
DramaClaw is Elastic License 2.0. Run it, modify it, sell what you build with it —
the standalone version is free for commercial use, no permission needed.
We ask for one thing: a small "Powered by DramaClaw" in the corner of your UI.
The only door still closed is wrapping it up as a hosted SaaS for other people; that license isn't open yet.
Why, and the FAQ: #475.

## What is DramaClaw? DramaClaw is a **self-hostable production line for AI drama**: from manuscript to finished episodes, and from a one-line brief to a short film. An agent and an infinite canvas share one asset library: - **Xia Director** — the built-in agent. Describe what you want; it plans the workflow, lays out the nodes and runs them with your confirmation. - **XiaHua** — the infinite canvas. Generate, edit and connect images, video, audio, 3D sets, interactive stories and scripts as nodes. - **Series (XiaJi)** — the pipeline. Drop in a novel or screenplay; DramaClaw structures the story, writes scripts, draws storyboards, voices the lines and cuts the film. Bring any model through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, run it on your own machine, and keep your material.

## 🆕 What's New Three things we have been building with our own production team, now in `main`. ### 🤖 Xia Director — from a brief to a running workflow

One brief → planned workflow → nodes on the canvas → generated assets → composed video.

- **Plans and runs canvas workflows** — turns a creative brief into a node graph, lays it out, and executes it after you confirm, with progress tracking and failure recovery. - **Workflow catalog, Skills and Recipes** — built-in workflows for short drama, e-commerce and IP character ads, social content, Japanese anime, LEGO-style animation and outdoor stage duels. Install, export and share Skill bundles, or **import an external `SKILL.md` / ZIP** and convert it into a native Skill. - **Builds web pages too** — ask for a landing page or story microsite; it becomes an editable HTML node with revision history and a self-contained ZIP export. - **Knows your project** — checks progress, advances script and shot tasks, finds missing deliverables and suggests what to do next. - **Your choice of brain** — ships with a bundled Codex runtime by default; point the Agent at any third-party model that supports the OpenAI Responses API and tool calls, independent of your media channels. - **Works from other agents** — [Agent Kit](agent-kit/README.md) exposes the same workflows over MCP to Codex, Claude Code, OpenClaw, WorkBuddy and any stdio MCP client. ### 🎥 3D Previz Stage — block the scene before you generate it

Reference image → 3D blockout → characters, cameras and timeline → recorded preview back on the canvas.

An in-browser previs stage that lives on the canvas as a node. Lock down space, blocking and framing first, then feed the result to image and video generation. - **Scene blockout** — generate a 3D scene from a reference image; drop props and they land on whatever surface is underneath. - **Characters and motion** — mannequins in five builds, placed from a top-down map; walk cycles that follow movement paths on a multi-track timeline. - **Cameras and cutting** — focal length, sensor size and placement per camera; a **program track** to cut between cameras (digit keys cut live) with the monitor following the edit. - **Audio track** — import audio from a local file or an upstream node, see waveforms, and mix it into recordings. - **Back to the canvas** — capture frames or record the program cut into connected nodes as references for the next generation. ### 🔀 Interactive Stories — audience choices shape the story

Branching story generation, canvas authoring, interactive playback and multiple endings.

- **AI story planning** — a brief becomes an outline and an editable branching narrative with choice points, endings and estimated runtime per route. - **Visual branching on the canvas** — arrange segments, videos and choices; edit dialogue, choice order and branch connections. - **Variables and conditions** — affinity, scores and other variables gate choices and decide endings; timed choices and default routes included. - **Produce media in place** — character, scene and storyboard references and per-segment videos, reusing every canvas asset. - **Playtest before rendering** — run the story with placeholder media, validate branch connectivity and conditional paths, inspect ending reach rates and path coverage. - **Ship a player** — export a standalone HTML player or an offline package with video, branching playback, progress and replay.

## 🚀 Quick Start You need Docker with `docker compose`. No GPU, database or queue is required — models run behind the gateway, state lives on local disk. ```bash git clone https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw.git cd dramaclaw cp .env.example .env # set PROMPT_EXPORT_PASSWORD to a non-default value docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml pull docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml up -d ``` Open , go to **Settings → Models & Channels**, and paste your DC key (get one at ) — or switch to **Custom** to use your own providers. That's it. The release Compose file runs the published **v2.1.1** multi-arch images (`DRAMACLAW_VERSION=2.1.1`, `DRAMACLAW_GATEWAY_VERSION=v1.0.0-rc.24-dramaclaw.3`). Mainland China users can switch to the ACR mirror with `DRAMACLAW_IMAGE_PREFIX`.

## ✨ Features ### XiaHua — the infinite canvas

One prompt to Xia Director (right) became this 17-node, 32-edge workflow (left): brief → story direction → character and set references → five first frames → five shot videos → voice-over and score → final cut.

- **One canvas, every medium** — image, video, audio, script, beat context, storyboard, style, skill, 360° panorama, 3D world, Previz, interactive story, web page and export nodes. Connect them freely; every node keeps its own generation history. - **Image tools** — generate, edit, redraw, outpaint, relight, upscale, multi-view, template edit, reverse-prompt, mark detection, and a **style wall of 45 short-drama looks**. - **Video tools** — text / image / keyframe to video, omni-reference generation with file, web-link and on-canvas references, video edit, erase, upscale, audio separation, camera templates and shot analysis; Seedance 2.5 in the recommended catalog. - **Audio and voice design** — speech synthesis, voice library, reference audio and music. **Describe a voice in words**, preview it, and save it to a character slot or **My voices** (needs a compatible audio model and `VOICE_DESIGN_ENABLED=1` with daily limits in [`.env`](.env.example)). - **Director World** — turn an image into a 3D Gaussian Splat set or a scene-360 panorama, frame the shot in the viewer, and reuse the same location consistently across shots. - **Built for big canvases** — tabs, outline, minimap, viewport bookmarks, snap-align, level-of-detail rendering, group nodes, shortcuts, revision history with restore and per-canvas locking. - **Commit to the series** — preview the impact, then promote a node or a batch into the asset library or an episode; project the series back onto a canvas.

### Series (XiaJi) — the pipeline

Every stage is an independent task with its own interface — run them in order, skip steps, resume from any checkpoint, or drive them from your own orchestrator. - **Structured ingest** — episodes, characters and scenes straight from a manuscript or screenplay (Fountain supported); no knowledge graph or embeddings required. - **Asset library (XiaTang)** — characters, scenes, props and voices organized by purpose; stable identities across episodes, portraits and per-episode variants. - **Episode planning and scripts** — chapter segmentation, beat planning, multi-episode arcs; adaptive / literal / staged script modes with review-and-repair loops. - **Storyboards and first frames** — beat-driven stylized generation, grid splitting, image-pool selection. - **Voice-over, composition and export** — emotion-aware speech, episode assembly, video + subtitle export and the full asset pack. - **Visual style** — extract style parameters from a reference image and apply them project-wide. - **Task Center** — status, progress, logs, cancel / retry and resume-from-checkpoint for long runs.

## 🤔 Why DramaClaw? - **A canvas that understands drama, and an agent that works on it.** Generic node canvases wire anything together but know nothing about episodes, characters or shots. DramaClaw's nodes and Skills do, and Xia Director plans and runs them for you. - **Canvas *and* pipeline.** Explore freely on the canvas, commit what works to the series, project the series back onto a canvas — one asset library, one agent. - **No black box.** Every stage is a decomposable task with its own API. Skip, resume, replace or script any step. - **Self-hostable and model-neutral.** Your manuscript, your characters, your models, your servers. ## DramaClaw 是什么？ DramaClaw 是一条**可自托管的 AI 漫剧生产线**：从原稿到成片剧集，从一句需求到一条短片。智能体与无限画布共用同一个资产库： - **虾导** —— 内置智能体。说出你想要什么，它规划工作流、在画布上铺好节点，经你确认后运行。 - **虾画** —— 无限画布。图片、视频、音频、3D 场景、互动剧、剧本都是节点，自由生成、编辑、连线。 - **虾集** —— 剧集流水线。丢进小说或剧本，DramaClaw 负责结构化故事、生成剧本、绘制分镜、配音并剪出成片。 任意模型都能通过 OpenAI 兼容网关接入；跑在你自己的机器上，素材留在你自己手里。

## 🆕 新功能 我们自己的制作团队一直在用的三项能力，现已进入 `main`。 ### 🤖 虾导 —— 从一句需求到跑起来的工作流

一句需求 → 规划工作流 → 画布铺节点 → 生成素材 → 合成视频。

- **规划并运行画布工作流** —— 把创作需求转成节点图、自动布局，经你确认后执行，带进度跟踪与失败恢复。 - **工作流目录、Skill 与 Recipe** —— 内置短剧、电商与 IP 角色广告、社媒内容、日系动漫、乐高风动画、户外擂台对决等工作流。Skill 包可安装、导出、分享，也能**导入外部 `SKILL.md` / ZIP** 并转换为原生 Skill。 - **还能做网页** —— 让它做落地页或故事专题页，结果是可编辑的 HTML 节点，带版本历史，可导出自包含 ZIP。 - **懂你的项目** —— 查看进度、推进剧本与镜头任务、找出缺失的交付物并建议下一步。 - **大脑由你选** —— 默认使用内置 Codex 运行时；也可以给智能体单独指定任意支持 OpenAI Responses API 和工具调用的第三方模型，不影响媒体生成渠道。 - **外部智能体也能用** —— [Agent Kit](../agent-kit/README.md) 通过 MCP 把同一套工作流开放给 Codex、Claude Code、OpenClaw、WorkBuddy 及任意 stdio MCP 客户端。 ### 🎥 3D 预演台 —— 先排好戏，再去生成

参考图 → 3D 白模场景 → 角色、机位与时间线 → 录制预演回到画布。

浏览器内的预演台，以节点形式挂在画布上。先锁定空间、站位和构图，再把结果交给图片与视频生成。 - **场景白模** —— 由参考图生成 3D 场景；拖入道具，松手即落到下方的表面上。 - **角色与动作** —— 五种体型的人偶，可在俯视图上选位；角色沿移动路径行走时自动播放步行动作，多轨时间线统一编排。 - **机位与切镜** —— 每台机位可调焦距、画幅与位置；**节目轨**在机位之间切换（数字键实时切），监视器跟随剪辑。 - **音频轨** —— 从本地文件或上游节点导入音频，显示波形，并混入录制结果。 - **回到画布** —— 截取画面或录制节目轨，写入相连节点，作为下一次生成的参考。 ### 🔀 互动剧 —— 观众的选择决定剧情

分支剧情生成、画布编排、互动播放与多结局。

- **AI 剧情规划** —— 一句需求生成大纲和可编辑的分支叙事，含选择点、结局和每条路线的预计时长。 - **画布上可视化编排分支** —— 排布剧情片段、视频与选项；编辑台词、选项顺序和分支连线。 - **变量与条件** —— 好感度、分数等变量控制可选项、决定结局；支持限时选择与默认路线。 - **就地制作素材** —— 角色、场景、分镜参考与分段视频，画布上的素材全部可复用。 - **先试玩再出片** —— 用占位素材跑通剧情，校验分支连通与条件路径，查看结局达成率与路径覆盖率。 - **导出播放器** —— 导出独立 HTML 播放器或含视频的离线包，支持分支播放、探索进度与已解锁片段重看。

## 🚀 快速开始 只需要 Docker 和 `docker compose`。不需要 GPU、数据库或消息队列 —— 模型跑在网关后面，状态存在本地磁盘。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw.git cd dramaclaw cp .env.example .env # 把 PROMPT_EXPORT_PASSWORD 改成非默认值 docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml pull docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml up -d ``` 打开 ，进入**设置 → 模型与渠道**，粘贴 DC key（到 获取）—— 或切到**自定义**接入你自己的供应商。就这样。 Release Compose 文件运行已发布的 **v2.1.1** 多架构镜像（`DRAMACLAW_VERSION=2.1.1`、`DRAMACLAW_GATEWAY_VERSION=v1.0.0-rc.24-dramaclaw.3`）。中国大陆用户可通过 `DRAMACLAW_IMAGE_PREFIX` 切换到阿里云 ACR 镜像。
其他运行方式
| 方式 | 适用场景 | 命令 | 指南 | |---|---|---|---| | **发布镜像** | 试用或自托管某个发布版本 | `docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml up -d` | [快速开始](../docs/zh/getting-started/quickstart.md) | | **源码 Docker** | 运行自己修改过的代码 | 把 [dramaclaw-gateway](https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw-gateway) clone 到本仓库旁边，然后 `docker compose up -d --build` | [自托管](../docs/zh/guides/self-hosting.md) | | **本地开发** | 热重载开发 DramaClaw | `scripts/start-ce.sh`（API `:8780` + 界面 `:5173`；需要 Python 3.11–3.12、`uv`、Node/pnpm、`ffmpeg`） | [安装](../docs/zh/getting-started/installation.md) | `scripts/start-ce.sh` 会为 macOS 或 Linux 下载打过补丁的 Codex **0.164.0** Agent 运行时，校验固定的 SHA256 后缓存到 `runtime/codex/bin/`。如需使用自己打过补丁的版本，在 `.env` 中设置 `CODEX_BIN`；Windows 用户请使用 WSL2 或 Docker。 从旧版 checkout 升级、固定版本、对外开放内置网关、使用自己的 Codex 二进制：见[自托管手册](../docs/zh/guides/self-hosting.md)和[故障排查](../docs/zh/guides/troubleshooting.md)。

## ✨ 功能 ### 虾画 —— 无限画布

对右侧的虾导说一句话，左侧画布上就长出了这张 17 个节点、32 条连线的工作流：需求 → 故事方向 → 角色与场景参考 → 五个镜头首帧 → 五段镜头视频 → 旁白与配乐 → 成片合成。

- **一张画布，所有媒介** —— 图片、视频、音频、剧本、节拍上下文、分镜、风格、技能、360° 全景、3D 世界、预演台、互动剧、网页与导出节点。任意连线，每个节点保留自己的生成历史。 - **图片工具** —— 生成、编辑、重绘、扩图、重打光、放大、多视角、模板编辑、反推提示词、标记检测，以及**内置 45 种漫剧风格的风格墙**。 - **视频工具** —— 文生 / 图生 / 首尾帧生视频，全能参考生成支持文件、网页链接和画布内素材做参考，视频编辑、擦除、放大、人声分离、运镜模板与镜头分析；推荐目录已含 Seedance 2.5。 - **音频与声音设计** —— 语音合成、声线库、参考音频与音乐生成。**用文字描述一个声音**，试听后保存到角色声线插槽或「我的音色」（需配置兼容的音频模型，并在 [`.env`](../.env.example) 中设置 `VOICE_DESIGN_ENABLED=1` 及每日额度）。 - **导演世界** —— 把图片变成 3D 高斯片场或场景 360 全景，在查看器里取景，同一场景跨镜头保持一致。 - **为大画布而生** —— 画布分页、元素大纲、小地图、视口书签、吸附对齐、分级渲染、分组节点、快捷键、历史版本回滚与画布级锁。 - **提交回剧集** —— 先预览影响，再把单个节点或整批结果写入资产库或某一集；也能把剧集投影回画布。

### 虾集 —— 剧集流水线

每个阶段都是带独立接口的任务 —— 可以按顺序跑、跳步跑、从任意检查点续跑，也能接入你自己的编排器。 - **结构化导入** —— 从原稿或剧本（支持 Fountain）直接生成剧集、角色与场景，无需知识图谱或向量。 - **资产库（虾塘）** —— 角色、场景、道具与声线按用途组织；跨集稳定的身份、定妆照与分集变体。 - **剧集规划与剧本** —— 章节切分、节拍规划、多集弧线；自适应 / 忠实原文 / 分阶段三种剧本模式，带审校与修复循环。 - **分镜与首帧** —— 节拍驱动的风格化生成、宫格拆分、图池挑选。 - **配音、合成与导出** —— 情绪感知配音、整集合成、视频 + 字幕导出及完整素材包。 - **视觉风格** —— 上传参考图提取风格参数，应用到整个项目。 - **任务中心** —— 状态、进度、日志、取消 / 重试，长任务可从检查点续跑。

## 🤔 为什么是 DramaClaw？ - **懂剧的画布，加一个在画布上干活的智能体。** 通用节点画布什么都能连，却不知道剧集、角色、镜头为何物。DramaClaw 的节点和 Skill 懂，虾导替你规划并运行它们。 - **画布与流水线并行。** 在画布上自由探索，把成立的结果提交进剧集，再把剧集投影回画布 —— 同一个资产库，同一个智能体。 - **没有黑箱。** 每个阶段都是可拆解、有独立 API 的任务。跳过、续跑、替换或脚本化任意一步。 - **可自托管，模型中立。** 你的原稿、你的角色、你的模型、你的服务器。闭源前沿模型或开放权重模型随时切换。 ### DramaClaw 横向对比 图例：✅ 完整 · ◐ 部分 · ○ 规划中 · ❌ 无 · — 未核实。竞品名称部分打码；对比依据公开的产品文档与定位。 | 能力 | L\*TV | R\*Hub | T\*Now | S\*ko | U\*dream | O\*II | J\*/K\* | **DramaClaw** | |---|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:| | 内置智能体（工作流规划、画布编排、执行） | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ○ | ✅ | ○ | ✅ | ✅ | | 工作流 Skill 与 Recipe（复用、导入、导出、分享） | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | ✅ | | 3D 预演台（站位、动作、机位、时间线、录制） | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | ✅ | | 互动剧（分支、变量、多结局） | ◐ | ◐ | ◐ | ✅ | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 无限画布（节点式、自由探索） | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | 双轨（主流水线 + 画布探索） | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 分镜预览（剧本 → 镜头、分镜板） | ◐ | ✅ | ◐ | ✅ | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 资产库（角色 / 场景 / 道具 / 声线） | ◐ | ❌ | ◐ | ✅ | ◐ | ○ | ❌ | ✅ | | 场景一致性（变体、360°、多状态） | ✅ | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ○ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 导演世界（360° / 3D 片场、机位、取景） | ✅ | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ◐ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 成片交付（多镜头、字幕 / SRT、素材包） | ✅ | ○ | ○ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 团队协作（共享、角色、任务、成本） | ✅ | ✅ | ○ | ✅ | ○ | ○ | ○ | ✅ | | 自定义风格（模板、提示词、负面词） | ✅ | ◐ | ○ | ✅ | ◐ | ○ | ◐ | ✅ | | 创作伙伴（人设、提醒、反馈） | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | | 源码可见（自托管、可 fork、可定制） | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
## 🔌 模型与供应商 所有文本、图片、视频、音频模型都通过 **OpenAI 兼容网关**接入。在**设置 → 模型与渠道**中选择模式： | 模式 | 你需要做的 | 适合 | |---|---|---| | **官方**（推荐） | 粘贴从 [RelayClaw](https://relayclaw.cdnfg.com) 获取的 DC key，所有模型映射已预置。 | 快速上手 | | **自定义** | 一键初始化内置的 [dramaclaw-gateway](https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw-gateway)，添加你自己的供应商渠道。 | 完全掌控供应商与成本 | | **本地 + 官方混合** | 主流水线走官方模型，另加你自己的渠道（如本地 ComfyUI 工作流）。 | 混用本地或小众模型 | 内置网关是 DramaClaw 基于 [New API](https://github.com/QuantumNous/new-api) 的分支，使用 DC-Media 协议，已内置以下适配器：**ComfyUI · MiniMax / 海螺 · 火山引擎豆包 / Seedance · fal.ai · 阿里云 · 可灵 · 即梦 · Vertex AI · Gemini · OpenAI / Sora · Suno**（[支持矩阵](https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw-gateway/blob/main/docs/providers/en/README.md)、[新增供应商](https://github.com/dramaclaw/dramaclaw-gateway/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)）。 智能体模型在**模型与渠道 → Agent 模型**中单独配置，可以跟随当前渠道，也可以使用任意支持 OpenAI Responses API 与工具调用的接口。详见[配置模型](../docs/zh/getting-started/configuring-models.md)。
